category_edits.rationale: Expand uniform causal pooling from four to eight encoder states across all four category models, retaining the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend. Broader observed context may better capture persistent interests. Existing nonpadding normalization and final-real-position inference remain consistent through the shared model class; synchronize saved and predictor metadata.

change_summary: Use eight-state causal uniform pooling in training and inference, updating checkpoint and embedded predictor metadata. Preserve the NextItNet backbone, history length, blend weights, scoring, loss, optimizer and per-category routing.
